'''Version 0.9.1.0''' is the patch released on 21 October 2026, five days after [[Version 0.9.0.2]]. This page lists every documented change from 0.9.0.2, including a few the patch notes do not mention. The wiki now shows values from [[Version 0.9.1.2]], which followed a day later.

== New content ==
=== Items ===
* [[Flint (Large)]] is a big flint stone. Searching fallen twigs, pebbles, mixed ground debris, boulders and cave-floor cracks now has a separate 2.5% chance to add one, on top of the usual Flint chance. It works like Flint as the stone when you light a fire, and it is the material for a Flint Dagger.
* [[Flint Dagger]] is crafted from one Flint (Large) for 8 AP in your personal crafting menu, which every character knows. It hits two cells for 1 damage each and has the same 5 AP action cost as an Iron Dagger, but only 20 durability. Its stone blade also works as the stone when you light a fire. It can also turn up in outdoor skeletons and on Raving and Mutated Unwanted corpses.

== Changes ==
=== Seeds ===
Planting any seed now costs 6 AP instead of 8. Crafting several seeds at the Primitive Farmwork Table is cheaper too. See [[Planting]].

=== Coins and gems ===
[[Copper Coin|Copper]], [[Silver Coin|Silver]] and [[Gold Coin|Gold Coins]] are now always worth their full value. Before, they had a hidden condition that wore down while they lay in a bag or other stash, so they sold for less, down to 10% of their value, and a stack left long enough could disappear. Coins that already wore down in an older save are worth their full value again. See [[Currency and trading]].

Not in the patch notes: the same fix covers the gems, [[Emerald]], [[Ruby]], [[Amethyst]], [[Sapphire]] and [[Topaz]].

=== Cloth vests ===
[[Forager's Vest]], [[Explorer's Vest]] and [[Expedition Vest]] now count as clothing, not armor. They no longer show the armor icon, and [[Tailor-Made]] no longer reduces their weight. Their armor value still adds to your Total Armor.

=== Rifts ===
Rifts no longer appear in [[Vast Waters]]. Before, Vast Waters areas near the [[Rift-Thorn Mire]] that holds the rift could get some. The change applies when an area is first generated; areas you have already visited load from your save unchanged.

=== Controls ===
* '''Balanced Zoom''' is a new option, on by default and recommended by the game. It makes the zoom range the same at every screen resolution: 30 tiles across fully zoomed out and 15 fully zoomed in. Before, the view was a fixed share of your screen, so a 4K screen showed twice as wide an area as a 1080p one. Turning the option off restores that. See [[Controls]].
* '''Scouting''' looks much further ahead. The patch notes say about 2.5 times; the furthest the view can slide toward the cursor is three times what it was, and the cursor must be twice as far from you to reach it. [[Version 0.9.1.2]] lets you click the far tiles you see.
* '''On-screen keyboard.''' When you name a new character, a button beside the name field opens an on-screen keyboard with letters, space, backspace, caps and enter, so you can name a character with only a mouse or controller. The prompt now reads "Press (your primary click) here to Confirm (or press Enter)".

== Fixes ==
=== Weight from bags on the ground ===
Eating or using an item, throwing one or placing one straight from a bag or container on the ground now lowers that container's weight. Before, its weight stayed too high. For an item with several uses, such as a remedy, each use removes its share of the weight.

=== The Sceetler's cellar ===
While you hunt the [[Sceetler]] for the rune, its cellar no longer fills with deadly creatures. Until the rune is found, other creatures out of your sight there vanish, and a new Sceetler appears if it is missing. See [[Quests and journal]].

=== Interface ===
* You can apply a remedy, such as a wound salve or bandage, while a container's menu is open.
* Menus underneath the menu you are using no longer react to the mouse, so hovering, clicking or scrolling only affects the menu on top.
* The journal could scroll to negative entry numbers and crash. It no longer can.
* Hovering over a building's door, or over anything right next to you, no longer shows a question-mark cursor in the dark.

=== Changing area ===
You no longer get stuck inside a boulder or other solid object when you arrive in an outdoor area; the game moves you to the nearest free spot.

Not in the patch notes:
* Entering [[Ihar]]'s shipwreck now places you one tile lower than before.
* The two huts of the [[Survivors' camp]] now clear trees and other objects that would overlap them when the camp is built.

=== Sounds ===
A faint knocking in the soft rain and a child's voice in the background of the daytime swamp ambience were edited out.

=== Main menu ===
Not in the patch notes: while the main menu fades out to start or load a game, it no longer starts a new song or adds snowflakes. The victory screen no longer sets off fireworks.
